explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration matching this theorem. It is a `rfl` simp lemma that unfolds the library's own definition `sigmaPresheafObjIso`, which identifies the sections of an arbitrary coproduct of schemes with the product of the sections on each piece. That definition is not in Mathlib: grepping for `sigmaPresheafObjIso` turns up nothing. The closest thing Mathlib has is the two-scheme version, `Scheme.coprodPresheafObjIso`, with its lemmas `coprodPresheafObjIso_hom_fst` and `coprodPresheafObjIso_hom_snd` in `AlgebraicGeometry/Limits.lean`. Those cover only `X ⨿ Y`, not an indexed family `∐ X`, so they do not state this result. Since the content of the theorem lies entirely in the library's own definition, it does not duplicate Mathlib.
